faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SRCC Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Project Associate-II position at Shri Ram College of Commerce is 05 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Master's Degree in Science/Technology/Relevant Discipline (Completed). Expertise in Computer Programming, Python, Data Analysis, Visualization, and Scholarly Databases is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 35,000/- plus 30% HRA, totaling Rs. 45,500 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Project Associate-II position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Female candidates as per University rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the SRCC Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online by filling out the Google Form provided in the "Important Links" section. Ensure all required details and documents are attached.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the SRCC Project Associate-II recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is project-based, specifically for a DST-funded research project on Social-Media for Science Communication at Shri Ram College of Commerce.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is located in Delhi, at Shri Ram College of Commerce.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include expertise in Computer Programming, Python, Data Analysis, Visualization, and Scholarly Databases, which can enhance a candidate's application.
